original.statement: The issuer now retries more quickly when its linked Secret is updated, fixing a high back-off timeout.

decision.reason: [ev-10c8b1c28d66] says that in 1.17.0 the issuer now retries more quickly when its linked Secret is updated. This fixes a high back-off timeout. The configuration stays the same and only the runtime behaviour changes, so behavior-changed is the right change type. No field, flag, value or endpoint is named, so a runtime-behaviour subject is the only family that fits. The name issuer-retry-on-secret-update is built from the evidence's own key words. Confidence is low because retry timing is not strictly wire or protocol behaviour.
